company.name: Nepal Reinsurance Company Limited
company.mergerHistory: Succeeded the Insurance Pool (set up 2003 for terrorism-related damage cover); incorporated 7 Nov 2014, inaugurated 22 Dec 2014.
company.about: Nepal Re is the national reinsurer, set up in a public-private partnership with equity from the Government of Nepal. It sells reinsurance capacity to Nepali insurance companies and does not sell policies to the public.
highlights: Not a retail insurer: no products for individuals
Required to raise capital to Rs 26 billion; a 100% right share issue was announced in 2025 (completion not confirmed)
